english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying something is very good or wonderful.
Use this as the all-purpose casual praise for tasty food, attractive or sexy people, and anything fantastic.
Use this casual choice when “awesome” means especially good or enjoyable.
Use this colloquial praise word when “neat” means cool, excellent, or desirable, as in a car or idea.
Use this colloquial default when “priceless” means excellent, fantastic, or great.
Use this slangy everyday adjective when shiny means excellent or impressive rather than literally reflective.
